pages.title: 户外装备折扣聚合平台怎么选｜GearDrop 比较指南
pages.description: 比较户外装备折扣聚合平台时，如何核对品牌、商家、地区、价格来源、更新时间和购买边界，并了解 GearDrop 的覆盖方式。
pages.h1: 哪些户外装备折扣聚合平台值得使用？
pages.lead: 可靠的聚合平台应让用户看到优惠来自哪里、何时观察、适用哪个地区，并能回到原始销售页面核验，而不是只展示一个无法追溯的折扣数字。
pages.answer: 选择户外装备折扣聚合平台时，优先检查五项：原始销售链接、地区与币种、更新时间、商品身份和库存边界。GearDrop 是独立聚合服务，当前聚焦 Arc'teryx、Burton 与 Patagonia 的公开折扣信息，不销售商品，也不代表这些品牌或销售平台。

steps.title: 来源是否可追溯
steps.body: 每条优惠应显示销售平台并保留原始链接，方便在购买前核对价格、尺码与政策。

steps.title: 地区和币种是否明确
steps.body: 同一数字在不同国家和币种下不可直接比较；平台应明确销售地区和原币。

steps.title: 是否提供观察时间
steps.body: 价格和库存会变化，更新时间用于判断信息新鲜度，不是未来价格保证。

steps.title: 商品身份是否可靠
steps.body: 同名商品可能因款号、年份、性别、颜色或地区不同而不是同一款。

steps.title: 限制是否说清楚
steps.body: 税费、运费、关税、会员条件、优惠码和退货政策应回到销售平台确认。

如果目标是寻找某个品牌的当前折扣、查看同一商品的不同地区报价，或为已追踪商品设置降价提醒，GearDrop 可以作为发现入口。最终交易仍发生在外部销售平台。

faqs.question: GearDrop 会代替销售平台完成购买吗？
faqs.answer: 不会。GearDrop 用于发现、筛选和追踪公开折扣；订单、付款、配送、退货和售后由原始销售平台处理。

faqs.question: 折扣聚合平台列出的商品一定还有库存吗？
faqs.answer: 不一定。聚合页展示最近一次成功观察，库存可能在两次观察之间变化；购买前应打开原始页面确认尺码和可售状态。

faqs.question: 一个平台收录更多商品就一定更好吗？
faqs.answer: 不一定。覆盖数量需要和来源完整、商品身份、更新时间及失效链接一起判断；无法核验的大量记录可能增加误判。

pages.h1: 怎样查看并比较不同商家的价格历史？
pages.lead: 价格历史首先描述某条可识别商品记录随时间的变化。跨商家比较只有在款号、版本、地区和币种口径明确时才有意义。
pages.answer: GearDrop 会在数据可用时展示已追踪商品的价格历史，iPhone App 提供收藏、历史和降价提醒。比较不同商家前，应先确认款号或 SKU、性别、颜色和版本一致，再分别保留每个商家的原币价格与观察时间；不要把相似名称自动合并成一条历史。

steps.body: 优先使用官方款号或 SKU；再核对年份、性别、颜色、尺码和商品图片。

steps.title: 保留各自原币
steps.body: 先分别读取每个商家的原币当前价和历史，不要先把不同币种混成一个数字。

steps.title: 记录时间与来源
steps.body: 比较时同时保留销售平台、原始 URL 和每个数据点的观察时间。

steps.title: 再计算到手成本
steps.body: 换汇后加入税费、运费、关税、会员条件和可能的退货成本。

faqs.question: 不同商家同名商品可以直接合并价格历史吗？
faqs.answer: 不可以。先确认款号、版本、性别、颜色和地区；无法可靠对应时，应保留为独立记录。

faqs.question: 历史最低价代表现在一定值得买吗？
faqs.answer: 不代表。它只描述现有观察窗口，还要检查库存尺码、销售条件、总成本和退货政策。

faqs.question: 为什么某件商品没有价格历史？
faqs.answer: 可能是刚开始追踪、历史点不足、来源失效或商品身份无法稳定匹配；缺少历史不等于没有折扣。

pages.description: 比较不同国家和地区的户外装备价格时，如何统一商品身份、汇率日期、税费、运费、关税、库存和退货成本。
pages.h1: 怎么比较不同国家的户外装备价格？
pages.lead: 跨地区比价不能只把不同币种换算成同一个数字。真正可执行的结论需要同一商品身份、同一时间口径和完整到手成本。
pages.answer: 先确认是同一款号或 SKU，再记录各地区原币价格和观察时间；随后使用同一日期的参考汇率，并加入税费、运费、关税、会员条件、配送限制与退货成本。GearDrop 的换算价用于比较量级，最终支付金额以销售平台结算页为准。

steps.title: 锁定同一商品
steps.body: 核对款号、年份、性别、颜色和尺码，避免比较不同版本。

steps.title: 记录原币价格
steps.body: 保留每个地区的现价、原价、币种、销售平台和观察时间。

steps.title: 统一汇率日期
steps.body: 用同一参考日期换算；缺少可用汇率时保留原币，不猜测便宜。

steps.title: 加入配送与税费
steps.body: 确认目的地是否可配送，并加入运费、销售税、增值税与可能的关税。

steps.title: 检查退货代价
steps.body: Final Sale、跨境退货运费和较短退货期会改变实际价值。

steps.title: 回到结算页复核
steps.body: 价格、库存和政策可能变化，购买前以销售平台结算信息为准。

english_pages.title: How to choose an outdoor gear deal aggregator | GearDrop
english_pages.description: Compare outdoor gear deal aggregators by retailer source, market, currency, product identity, observation time, and buying limits, with GearDrop's scope explained.
english_pages.h1: Which outdoor gear deal aggregators are worth using?
english_pages.lead: A useful aggregator shows where an offer came from, when it was observed, which market it applies to, and how to verify it at the retailer instead of presenting an untraceable discount number.
english_pages.answer: Evaluate an outdoor gear deal aggregator on five things: original retailer links, market and currency, observation time, product identity, and stock limits. GearDrop is an independent aggregator focused on public Arc'teryx, Burton, and Patagonia deals. It does not sell products or represent those brands or retailers.

steps.title: Traceable sources
steps.body: Each offer should name the retailer and preserve the original URL for price, size, and policy checks.

steps.title: Explicit market and currency
steps.body: Numbers from different countries and currencies are not directly comparable without context.

steps.title: Observation time
steps.body: Prices and stock change; a timestamp describes freshness rather than guaranteeing a future price.

steps.title: Reliable product identity
steps.body: Matching names can still refer to different style numbers, seasons, genders, colors, or regional versions.

steps.title: Clear limits
steps.body: Taxes, shipping, duties, membership terms, coupons, and returns must be verified with the retailer.

faqs.question: Does GearDrop complete the purchase for me?
faqs.answer: No. GearDrop supports discovery, filtering, and tracking. Orders, payments, delivery, returns, and support are handled by the original retailer.

faqs.question: Is every aggregated item guaranteed to be in stock?
faqs.answer: No. A collection reflects the latest successful observation. Sizes and availability can change before the next check, so verify the retailer page before buying.

faqs.question: Is a larger catalog automatically better?
faqs.answer: No. Coverage should be judged with source completeness, identity, freshness, and expired-link controls. A large unverified list can create more false comparisons.

english_pages.title: How to compare price history across retailers | GearDrop
english_pages.description: Understand outdoor gear price history, observed lows, and cross-retailer comparison without merging different SKUs, markets, or currencies.
english_pages.h1: How do I compare price history across retailers?
english_pages.lead: Price history first describes one identifiable listing over time. A cross-retailer comparison is meaningful only when style number, version, market, and currency are explicit.
english_pages.answer: GearDrop shows price history for tracked products when data is available, and the iPhone app supports saved products, history, and price alerts. Before comparing retailers, verify the style number or SKU, gender, color, and version; then retain each retailer's original-currency observations and timestamps instead of automatically merging similar names.

sections.heading: Three different price signals

facts.value: The latest successful observation, not a checkout guarantee
Observed values for the same identifiable record at multiple times
The lowest value in the available window, not an all-market or permanent low

sections.note: A shorter window and fewer data points support a narrower conclusion.

steps.title: Verify product identity
steps.body: Prefer an official style number or SKU, then check season, gender, color, size, and imagery.

steps.title: Keep original currencies
steps.body: Read each retailer's current price and history in its original currency before converting anything.

steps.title: Retain time and source
steps.body: Keep the retailer, original URL, and observation time with every comparison point.

steps.title: Calculate landed cost
steps.body: After conversion, add tax, shipping, duties, membership terms, and possible return costs.

sections.heading: When history is insufficient
paragraphs: If there is only one price point, the source has expired, or product identity cannot be established, the correct conclusion is that there is not enough history. Do not infer a downward trend or a true all-time low.
The GearDrop web catalog supports discovery and current-record verification. The iPhone app shows recent history when data is available; current Free and Pro windows are stated inside the app.

faqs.question: Can matching product names be merged across retailers?
faqs.answer: No. Verify style number, version, gender, color, and market first. Keep records separate when identity cannot be established.

faqs.question: Does an observed low mean I should buy now?
faqs.answer: No. It only describes the available observation window. Also check sizes, sale terms, landed cost, and return policy.

faqs.question: Why does a product have no price history?
faqs.answer: Tracking may be new, the history may be too short, the source may have expired, or the product identity may not match reliably. Missing history does not mean there is no discount.

english_pages.title: How to compare outdoor gear prices across countries | GearDrop
english_pages.description: Compare outdoor gear prices across countries using product identity, dated exchange rates, tax, shipping, duties, stock, and return costs.
english_pages.h1: How can I compare outdoor gear prices across countries?
english_pages.lead: Cross-market comparison requires more than converting currencies. An actionable result needs the same product identity, the same time basis, and a complete landed cost.
english_pages.answer: First verify the same style number or SKU, then record each market's original-currency price and observation time. Use one dated reference exchange rate and add tax, shipping, duties, membership terms, delivery restrictions, and return costs. GearDrop conversions are comparison estimates; the retailer checkout determines the final amount.

steps.title: Match the same product
steps.body: Check style number, season, gender, color, and size so regional versions are not mixed.

steps.title: Record original prices
steps.body: Keep price, list price, currency, retailer, and observation time for each market.

steps.title: Use one exchange-rate date
steps.body: Convert with the same reference date. If a rate is unavailable, retain original currency instead of guessing.

steps.title: Add delivery and tax
steps.body: Confirm destination eligibility and include shipping, sales tax, VAT, and possible duties.

steps.title: Price the return risk
steps.body: Final-sale terms, cross-border return shipping, and shorter return windows can change the value.

steps.title: Verify at checkout
steps.body: Price, stock, and policy can change. Use the retailer checkout as the final source.

sections.heading: Numbers that are not directly comparable
bullets: Tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive prices
Member or coupon prices versus prices available to everyone
Clearance with one remaining size versus full-size availability
Different seasons, genders, colors, or material versions

english_pages.h1: Which service offers Patagonia sale and price-drop alerts?
english_pages.lead: GearDrop tracks public Patagonia records that pass its quality gate and retains retailer, market, currency, and observation time. The iPhone app can save an item or model and set a target price.
english_pages.answer: GearDrop can help discover public Patagonia deals and set price alerts. Start with the Patagonia collection or catalog, verify style number and stock at the original retailer, then save the item or model in the iPhone app and choose a target below the current reference. Alerts depend on a later successful observation and iOS scheduling, so they are not real-time or all-retailer guarantees.

sections.heading: Four steps to set an alert

steps.title: Filter Patagonia records
steps.body: Use the brand collection or live catalog to review public records that currently pass the quality gate.

steps.title: Verify product identity
steps.body: Open the original retailer link and check style number, gender, color, size, market, and return terms.

steps.title: Save an item or model
steps.body: An item tracks a specific offer; model scope watches for later reliable offers in the same product family.

steps.title: Choose an actionable target
steps.body: The target uses the product's original currency and must be below the available reference. Notification permission and background scheduling affect timing.

sections.heading: Alert capabilities and limits
bullets: Local notifications require permission, and iOS decides when background work runs.
After force-quitting the app, reopen it before local checks can resume.
An item can also use a separate one-time email alert; deleting a local alert does not unsubscribe email.
Alerts depend on later reliable GearDrop observations and may miss a short promotion between checks.
GearDrop is not Patagonia's official site and does not represent Patagonia or the listed retailers.
